items.text: Tuesday report: New England G Alijah Vera-Tucker and G Ben Brown did not practice; Mike Vrabel said both will 'probably not' play. WR A.J. Brown, OT Morgan Moses and CBs Carlton Davis III and Karon Prunty were limited. Drake Maye full.
Chicago: RB Kyle Monangai, LB T.J. Edwards and LB Jack Sanborn (concussion) did not practice; G Jonah Jackson limited. Caleb Williams is not on the report.
New England WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is on IR.
